collection.description: A pod of orcas follows the outer reef: fishers want them chased off, children want to watch.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: A pod of orcas follows the outer reef. Some fishers want to chase them away, while children beg to watch.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: The children record surfacing patterns without disturbing the pod.

c.name: Answer C
c.text: The animals change course; the villagers realize they know little about their intentions.

d.name: Answer D
d.text: The gathering becomes a lesson in uncertainty rather than proof of a legend.

b__fx.name: Answer B
b__fx.text: Fishers lose a day of catch but avoid a close encounter.
